# elizaos-plugins/registry Daily Update (Apr 12, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
The registry repository underwent a significant cleanup on April 12, 2026, with a focus on closing stale issues, deprecating legacy CLI scaffolding, and clarifying the policy for third-party plugin submissions.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS
*   **None**
    *   No code changes or features were merged into the registry repository today.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   [#337](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/pull/337) add @hashlock/plugin-hashlock: A new pull request to register the hashlock plugin.

## CLOSED ISSUES
*   **Stale Issue Cleanup**
    *   A large volume of stale issues (8+ months old) were closed, including V3 goals ([#4720](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/4720)), security roles ([#5386](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/5386)), and various feature requests like Pump.fun migration ([#4908](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/4908)) and HyperEVM support ([#4909](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/4909)).
*   **Third-Party Plugin Proposals**
    *   Numerous plugin and integration proposals were closed with the instruction that these should be developed in their own repositories under `elizaOS-plugins` and published to npm. This includes proposals for AgentFolio ([#6634](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6634), [#6635](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6635)), AgentID ([#6644](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6644), [#6688](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6688)), and various commerce/payment integrations ([#6668](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6668), [#6695](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6695)).
*   **CLI Scaffolding Deprecation**
    *   Issues related to the `elizaos` CLI installation ([#6636](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6636), [#6704](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6704)) were closed, noting that the CLI scaffolding is deprecated in favor of the examples repository.

## NEW ISSUES
*   **None**

## ACTIVE ISSUES
*   [#6514](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6514) **Inter-Agent Coordination**
    *   A discussion regarding multi-agent coordination patterns. Participants highlighted the need for capability exchange and persistent peer relationships. Contributors suggested using on-chain credentials (via `eliza-plugin-insumer`) and behavioral sequences (via WTRMRK) to establish trust anchors across different agent instances and sessions.
*   [#6365](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/issues/6365) **AI Agent Payment Implementation**
    *   A lengthy discussion regarding payment infrastructure for agents. Participants debated the necessity of pre-transaction checks, including agent identity verification, recipient screening, and trust-based spend limits. The conversation involved multiple third-party providers (MAXIA, Coin Railz) discussing how to integrate their respective payment rails and marketplace layers.
